For larger jurisdictions, it offers confidence that co-signatories have the competencies needed to manage shared tax responsibilities responsibly and effectively. Therefore, embedding a creature such as a center of excellence within the framework convention could transform capacity building from discretionary as it is right now within the UN system to a more interconnected component of the treaty architecture. and it would make the work that we're doing here definitely more effective.
